sloka: ततः योध अन्गनाः सर्वा भर्तृऋन् सर्वान् गृहे गृहे ।यात्रा गमनम् आज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः ॥२-८२-२५॥
transliteration: tataḥ yodha anganāḥ sarvā bhartṛṛn sarvān gṛhe gṛhe ।yātrā gamanam ājñāya tvarayanti sma harṣitāḥ ॥2-82-25॥

translations.english: Then, the wives of the soldiers having come to know of the expedition were all delighted and in every household hastened up their husbands.
